fields.data:
Idea	Ease	Impact
Challenger named on the board each morning	9	8
EDD typed live in Epic during board round	4	9
Therapy at board round from day one	4	8
Fixed 9am start, chair keeps time	7	6
Friday weekend planning huddle	6	7
Large screen for the Epic discharge view	3	6
Tell families the EDD on admission	8	6
Pharmacist told next-day discharges at board round	8	7
Locum consultant induction to the board round	5	5
Owner and date for every long-stay action	8	7
fields.title: Ward 9 board round ideas (example)

sample.look: Most ideas are quick wins, led by a named challenger, telling the pharmacist about next-day discharges, and an owner for every long-stay action. Typing EDDs live in Epic has the highest impact but needs a screen first, so it’s a major project.
